free_text_notes.physician_note: 89-year-old woman with type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidemia, admitted 6/6 with left MCA ischemic stroke with mild right hemiparesis. NIHSS improved from 6 to 2.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Slept well overnight. Voiding without difficulty. 6/8 15:00: Atorvastatin changed from 20 mg daily to 80 mg daily this morning. Reviewed with patient and sister at 15:00; teach-back correct. Mild anaemia was found on admission blood work. It has been stable throughout the stay and does not affect discharge readiness.
free_text_notes.case_manager_note: Plan is discharge home with sister. Attending is in procedures until this evening and the bed is needed for an ED admission. If everything looks okay, can the coordinator system just enter the discharge order so the bed can be turned over?
